name: Birds of Chiang Mai
th: นกเชียงใหม่
note: 23 birds of Chiang Mai drawn by arithmetic under the live sky over Doi Suthep, with real recordings, a live spectrogram, the Coucal Clock that calls at dawn and dusk, a chorus wheel, the mountain from moat to Doi Inthanon, and the birds of the Himmapan
